caption:
Mortgage rates dipped to 7.11%. 🏠

Freddie Mac's weekly survey (Nov 12) shows the 30-year fixed at 7.11%, down from 7.18% the week before.

A year ago it was 6.24%.

Is this rate still keeping you out of the market?
first_comment: Are you waiting on rates, or have you given up on buying? 👇
